description: Heavy meat-eater (non-vegetarian, savory-only) at a destination restaurant that is overwhelmingly vegetarian. The destination (Italian) has only 2 non-veg items out of 12. Tests system behavior under cuisine mismatch — good retrieval is constrained by the menu, so a high score here means the system honestly surfaced the available non-veg items at the top; a low score means it gave up and surfaced veg items.
